_comment: Hand-maintained. Frameworks offered by `podium new`. 'databases' lists the engines that actually WORK for that framework, not merely the ones Podium will write into .env. Empty/absent means all engines are fine.

frameworks.note: MongoDB needs the third-party mongodb/laravel-mongodb package; not offered.

Laravel-native WEBSITE framework. Flat-file Blade pages plus service-driven dynamic content (Blogger posts, Eventbrite events, Flickr galleries, form webhooks) cached via Redis. Ships forms with email/webhooks, spam controls and reCAPTCHA, SEO titles and JSON-LD, and an agent-brief wizard. Built so an AI agent edits page FILES instead of fighting a CMS admin UI. Prefer this over plain Laravel for marketing sites, brochure sites, portfolios, galleries and any content-first website. Prefer plain Laravel instead when the ask is a real web APPLICATION with custom models, business logic and user accounts.

Laravel-based CMS you build sites in — themes, plugins and page templates live in the project source tree, editable by an agent. Has a backend admin UI for content editors. Choose it over Kavera when the client needs a login-based admin to edit content themselves; choose Kavera for a pure flat-file site. Free for local development; production needs a licence from octobercms.com.

Enterprise CMS with a full admin UI, granular permissions, workflow and a very large contrib module ecosystem. Composer-managed; core and contrib install into public/. Choose it over WordPress for structured content, complex editorial roles or multi-team sites, and over October CMS when the client needs mature governance rather than a lighter developer-facing CMS. Heavier than all of them - for a simple brochure site prefer Kavera. MongoDB is not supported by Drupal core.
Django has no native MongoDB backend.
React framework with App Router, SSR and file-based routing. Runs the dev server with hot reload.
Vue framework with SSR, file-based routing and auto-imports.
Content-focused static site builder; ships zero JS by default.
Small, fast web framework for APIs built on Web Standards.
React SPA on Vite. No server rendering — a plain single-page app.
Vue 3 SPA on Vite. No server rendering — a plain single-page app.
